10 Configuration specification
In general, this chapter defines configuration parameters and their clustering into
containers.
For general information about the definition of containers and param-
eters, refer to the [5, chapter 10.1 "Introduction to configuration specification" in
SWS_BSWGeneral].
Section 10.1 specifies the structure (containers) and the parameters of the Ttcan
module.
Section 10.2 specifies published information of the Ttcan module.
